evidence: Cato, Agr. 18.7: dē glāreā et calce harēnātō prīmum corium facitō, the first layer of a floor
Cicero, Q. fr. 3.1.4: pulvis, nōn glārea injecta est, of an approach road on a slope
terms.comment: A collective material noun. Lewis & Short cites road-building use. Morgan–Owens also lists it.
The medical “gravel” sense of calculus at the same Morgan–Owens headword is not the building material intended here.
